topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The familiar hum of the office feels different now. The chair beside mine sits empty, the desk cleared of the scattered papers that once mapped out another’s tasks. It’s quiet, but not in a good way. The hallway echoes with footsteps, but they aren’t the ones I’m used to hearing. The space feels larger somehow, more open, yet it’s harder to breathe. The routine carries on, but the air around me seems to linger, waiting for something that won’t come back. I find myself checking the time, remembering, missing the moments we shared without even realizing they mattered so much.
